_schema_note: Raster-vs-ray-march agreement bands on worlds this repository owns (RS4), for tests/test_render_agreement_matrix.cpp's AgreementMatrix. Plan: docs/design/rendering/plans/2026-10-03-agreement-bands-plan.md. Measurements are VERSIONED (SR-31): 'active_measurement_version' selects the live one, and a re-measure adds a version and never edits a pinned one. A camera is part of what a band measures, so a changed camera is a new version. Each later version states its root cause (TD-2).
_margin_rule: band = round_up(0.001, max(0.001, 1.5 * d)). Signed off by Test/Docs under TD-2 on 2026-10-03, with four conditions: (1) d is recorded per toolchain (msvc-release, msvc-debug, gcc-release) and must be bit-identical, since both paths are deterministic CPU code under TD-3; a difference is a finding to root-cause, never a reason to widen a band or keep per-toolchain bands; (2) d_probe and probe_over_band are recorded per case, and a case with d_probe < 2 x band goes to Test/Docs before pinning; (3) a later version states its root cause, and a band that cannot be met is a grade change (L3), not a wider band; (4) the 0.001 floor is a fraction of the frame, about 19 px at 160x120, so a change of resolution re-derives every band.
_camera_convention: position in metres; yaw_radians turns the view about world +Y from looking down -Z (positive yaw turns toward -X); pitch_radians tilts it up (positive) or down. Orientation = yaw quaternion * pitch quaternion, built with core/fp32_math.hpp's sin32/cos32 so every toolchain frames the same camera. Vertical FOV is render::Camera's default, 60 degrees.
_probe_rule: SR-30: the probe reference is the ground-only world (strip_to_ground_plane_only) when scene_from_world() finds an analytic ground plane, else the world with every static SDF node removed (all sky). detects_total_deletion is d_probe > band, re-checked live every run.
